summary: Phase 2 e2e of TrackPrep AI: Razorpay webhook (bad sig/unknown event/underpaid/activate/duplicate/extend/unmatched+claim), /api/payments/mine, Daily Streak (increments after daily submit, week array, completed_today), Mistake Notebook (add on wrong, skip excluded, PATCH mastered toggle, DELETE, 404 isolation, dedupe), Share Score Card canvas (1080x1080, non-blank pixels, WhatsApp/Copy/Download), Notebook UI (counts, tabs, subject chips, master/unmaster round-trip), Result page notebook banner, Daily Task page completed card, Pricing (razorpay button opens link with ?email=<encoded>, waiting banner, auto-activate+redirect+PRO badge after signed webhook, claim-via-activate dialog for unmatched payment). 8/8 pytest + 3 Playwright scenarios green.
critical_code_review_comments: Pricing payLink depends on Razorpay short URL (rzp.io) preserving ?email= query across redirect. In practice the short URL redirects to razorpay.com/payment-link/plink_... and QUERY PARAMS ARE STRIPPED. Email prefill is NOT reaching the Razorpay checkout. The webhook still activates by matching the TrackPrep user's email (as warned in UI), but the convenience of prefilling is lost. Consider using the long-form payment link or Razorpay 'prefill' with Orders API.
ShareScoreCard uses canvas 2D getImageData hot-path which triggered browser warning 'willReadFrequently' - minor perf hint; can set context attribute if we start reading pixels on every render.
Notebook AccordionContent is lazy-mounted (Radix default); 'notebook-unmaster-N' testid is only in DOM when item is expanded. Not a bug, but worth noting in testing contract and docs.
server.py is 890 lines — getting close to the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting payments/, mistakes/, daily/, auth/ routers for maintainability.
razorpay_webhook returns 503 if RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty — fine for dev, but no startup validation to force setting it in prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all target testids present and interactions working)

test_credentials: daily_test_user@test.io / password123 (PRO, 1-day streak, 2 open mistakes — state restored at end). Fresh users created ad-hoc per destructive test.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Each test registered ephemeral users (pricing_ok_*, wh_auto_*, claim_dlg_*, mistaker_*, streaker_*, etc.) and fired synthetic signed webhooks. daily_test_user state was mutated (1 mistake mastered during UI test) then restored via API (both mistakes back to open).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 features all working. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py is idempotent (uses fresh users per test). Known UX note: Razorpay rzp.io short link strips query params when redirecting to razorpay.com — frontend code DOES send ?email= but it doesn't reach the Razorpay form. Also Radix AccordionContent is lazy-rendered, so unmaster/delete/explanation testids require expanding the item first.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The only observable test-oddity was that /api/auth/me returns {user: {...}} not the user flat; my first test attempt asserted on the flat shape — fixed by unwrapping .user. UI test previously saw AI Explanation text absent in collapsed accordion — purely a timing/selector artifact (verified explanations are 250+ chars server-side).
